blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Dengue cases in Northern Samar have more than doubled this year compared with the same period in 2025, prompting Gov. Harris Ongchuan to order intensified surveillance, mosquito-control operations and public awareness campaigns to prevent further infections.
